unbaselined.06_hover_row_star_dark: the capture is byte-identical to 01_home_dark: t2 lives in the collapsed 'Stars' folder, so the row the hover hook targets is not rendered and the hollow-star affordance never appears. A baseline here would claim coverage of a state it does not show. Fix the state (open the folder, or hover a row that is visible), then baseline it.
unbaselined.07b_hover_msg_copy_dark: the hover action bar renders an ABSOLUTE clock time (fmtutil::clock_time of a mock stamp seeded at now-N), so the image changes every minute — two runs four minutes apart differ by 32 pixels, 06:08 vs 06:09. Freezing the capture clock does not help: the datum moves with the wall clock too. Baselining this needs the mock seeded from a fixed epoch during capture.
unbaselined.20_big_transcript_dark: the rbig perf fixture is seeded at now-80h..now-36h, so local midnight sweeps through it as the day passes: for ~7% of the day (20 of 288 five-minute samples) a calendar-day boundary falls inside the last eight messages and a date divider enters the visible tail, shifting the layout. Deterministic within a run, unstable across the day.
unbaselined.24_thread_loading_dark: the capture is byte-identical to 03_transcript_dark: the mock resolves the transcript fetch synchronously, so HANABI_LOADING_DEMO's per-thread loading state is already gone by the settle frames. Same class of bug the thinking demo had (the loader replaces openSession during the settle). Fix the knob, then baseline it.
unbaselined.32_new_messages_dark: same rbig fixture and same sweeping date divider as 20_big_transcript_dark.
